note: STRICT-002 deny network, recorded in the declared Linux environment. The worker is launched with unshare --net, so the action runs in a fresh network namespace with no route out. Evidence is behavioural rather than an inventory: the probe opens a TCP socket and attempts a real connection to 1.1.1.1:53, and the case passes when the sandbox refuses it ('the refused connection is the finding'). An earlier /proc/net/dev inventory check was abandoned: it reports what the kernel lists, which is weaker evidence, and inside a chroot with only procfs mounted it read as empty rather than isolated. Fault proof: dropping the --net flag makes the connection succeed and the case fail (exit 1); revert byte-identical (diff clean).
authority: self-reported local review, not independent attestation
